4pxj:
Architecture is a rewarding and culturally important profession. Architects play a crucial role in shaping society by crafting functional, responsible, and aesthetically pleasing structures while also considering the wellbeing, safety, and sustainability of the communities they serve.

The Architecture BA(Hons) course provides the first step in qualifying as a professional architect, with graduates exempt from Part 1 of the RIBA examination.

Students will explore modern architectural practices and consider how their work engages with society and its surroundings. They will analyze who the structures are for, what informs their design and structure, and what their legacy will be.

The course covers a wide range of architectural thinking, from applied science and technology to the humanities and fine arts.
4rjk:
Program Description

Criminology and sociology is the ideal degree if you seek to understand the changing world we live in. It takes a stimulating approach to the two subjects that share many theories and concepts. Informed by both established and radical new perspectives, the course encourages you to consider the impacts of social inequality and social change taking place both locally and globally and its causes and consequences.

You’ll benefit from a placement in the local community and from visiting guest speakers who share their knowledge on a wide range of topics. Through option modules you can tailor the course to your interests and you can also choose to go on an international exchange in Spain or Sweden.
4q21:
The NCTJ-accredited multi-platform course offered by the institution provides students with a comprehensive set of skills necessary for a successful career in journalism. This includes training in reporting, digital production, feature writing, and shorthand.

In addition to their degree, students will have the opportunity to earn the National Council for the Training of Journalists (NCTJ) Diploma in Journalism, a respected qualification that serves as an entry point into the professional journalism field.

The course is led by experienced media industry professionals and esteemed academics who guide students in developing essential journalism skills, critical thinking, academic research, and writing techniques. Students will have access to industry-standard facilities, such as a newsroom with live news and sports feeds, as well as equipment for sound, filming, and editing.

Students will also have the chance to attend lectures and masterclasses led by industry experts, participate in field trips, complete a placement, and showcase their work on the student-run website starting from the first day of the program.
4q32:
Program Description

This exciting new course, based in a city with a thriving music scene, gives students a thorough grounding in the music business and media. Students will have the opportunity to develop a range of skills and experiences, preparing them for a career in these fast-growing, rapidly changing and closely connected industries.

The teaching team comprises research-active lecturers and industry-experienced staff. Visiting professionals from the media and music industries play an influential part in the delivery of the course material.

All modules take an applied approach where theory and practice are combined. The degree can be tailored to specific interests, and students can experiment with different subjects and practices.
4q47:
The social science degree course offers students the opportunity to explore various perspectives in fields such as criminology, sociology, psychology, and social policy. Students have the flexibility to customize their degree based on their interests and career goals, allowing them to specialize in a specific area or maintain a more general approach.

Students will have the opportunity to participate in a placement within the local community, gaining practical skills and theoretical knowledge. Additionally, guest lecturers will provide insights on a variety of topics, enhancing the learning experience.
4q24:
Program Description

The foundation year course offers a year of integrated study at foundation level, opening up opportunities if students do not hold the required A-levels or equivalent qualifications, are changing career or returning to study.

Students will be able to develop the knowledge and skills needed to progress to a law degrees.

As well as gaining academic knowledge of the principles of law and business, students will explore the fundamentals of applied numeracy and data handling, life skills, citizenship and how to prepare themselves for studying an honours degree at Brighton.
4q22:
Program Description

The qualifying Law LLB(Hons) degree combines academic study with opportunities to experience law in practice, preparing students for a career as a legal professional.

Taken over three years, or four years with an optional salaried placement, core learning provides practical skills in presentation, negotiation, oration, mooting and advocacy, and a thorough understanding of the English legal system.

This degree is recognised by the Solicitors Regulation (SRA) Authority and the Bar Standards Board. It is a qualifying law degree, which means when students graduate they will have completed the academic stage of training for entry into the legal profession.

The SRA are introducing the new Solicitors Qualification Examination (SQE), which will replace the existing Legal Practice Course in autumn 2021.
4q25:
Program Description

The qualifying law degree Law with Business LLB(Hons) provides a detailed understanding of the legal framework that businesses operate within, preparing students for careers in the legal profession and many business environments.

Taken over three years, or four years with an optional salaried placement, core learning provides practical skills in presentation, negotiation, oration, mooting and advocacy and develops an understanding of the English legal system.

As they progress, option modules provide opportunities to tailor learning. Learning is delivered through a stimulating mix of seminars, guest lectures, skills sessions and workshops. Extracurricular activities, such as industry-sponsored mooting and client interviewing competitions and pro bono work, allow students to further develop practical skills in problem-solving, critical analysis and communication.

This degree is currently recognised by the Solicitors Regulation (SRA) Authority and the Bar Standards Board. It is a qualifying law degree, which means that Law LLB(Hons) graduates will have completed the academic stage of training for entry into the legal profession.

The SRA have announced that they are introducing a new qualifying exam – the Solicitors Qualification Exam (SQE) – which will take the place of the existing Legal Practice Course.
4q5r:
Program Description

The Master of Architecture (MArch) RIBA Part II course is a highly creative, research-led and professional two-year masters rooted in studio laboratories and driven by individual enquiry. The MArch course is prescribed by the ARB and validated by RIBA, giving exemption from RIBA Part II.

The design studio laboratories are driven by tutors’ personal research agendas and all staff are actively engaged within this field of enquiry as academics or practitioners. The stimulating mix of practitioners and academics across the course builds conversations, with visiting lecturers and critics further feeding the dialogue.
4q5l:
The future urban environments are being shaped by the design of buildings, larger developments, and landscapes. The student will work across the disciplines of architecture, art, and cultural geography, combining critical debate and artistic practice to aid their development as a designer of physical settings.

The course is highly experimental, aiming to stretch the imagination and critical ability of the individual. They will engage with research on the analysis of city spaces and explore the current issues of global urbanism. Leading their own projects, they will speculate on how urban environments will evolve and graduate with a significant portfolio of work.

In the vibrant backdrop of Brighton, a supportive studio environment and diverse workshops and seminars taught by architects and urban designers are offered.
4qck:
The Sports Journalism course offers vital multi-platform and multimedia skills, along with exclusive connections to Arsenal FC and Brighton & Hove Albion FC.

The program is designed for individuals who have completed an undergraduate degree in a non-journalism field or are seeking a professional qualification for a career in journalism.

Led by industry professionals and academics, students will have the opportunity to publish their work within the program.

Benefiting from strong partnerships with national organizations such as Sky Sports News, The Independent, The Sun, Daily Star, TalkSPORT, and the Mail Online.
4qa0:
This Master of Laws - Law Conversion postgraduate qualifying law courses expand the knowledge of those working in the justice, social, and consumer sectors, as well as supporting a move to a career as a barrister or solicitor.

This course has the following key features:

- Recognized by the Solicitors Regulation Authority and the Bar Standards Board, this LLM enables graduates in non-law-related studies to convert to a career in law.

- Experienced lecturers at Brighton Law School will support students through this practice-led, skills-based course, integrating guest talks from local practitioners and judges.

- Extracurricular activities, such as mooting, client interviewing, and pro bono work, allow students to develop practical skills in legal research, problem-solving, critical analysis, and communication.
4q4v:
The Accounting ACCA program is offered on a part-time and full-time basis. The part-time study option is available to UK (home) applicants only.

This course is an embedded Masters as accredited by the ACCA. The university is proud to be an ACCA Gold Learning Partner.

ACCA membership also provides access to the institute’s resources and the opportunity to network with senior professionals and executives. By following the ACCA’s syllabus for the Strategic Professional stage, students can graduate with a Masters degree or Postgraduate Diploma alongside studying the relevant modules required to become a Chartered Certified Accountant. To gain the ACCA qualification, students must pass the ACCA’s external exams.
9dsq:
Business leaders today are facing unprecedented challenges, including economic uncertainty, technological change and shifting international markets. The Global MBA prepares students to address these challenges and succeed in an increasingly interconnected world.

Designed for ambitious professionals and graduates seeking to accelerate their careers, the MBA focuses on global challenges, digital transformation and responsible leadership. Students explore how organisations operate across international markets, examine the impact of emerging technologies such as AI and blockchain, and learn how businesses can respond to ethical and economic challenges on a global scale.

Through practical learning, expert teaching from international lecturers and a live consultancy project, students develop the confidence and skills needed to lead organisations through complexity and change. The Global MBA provides a flexible and practical route to developing advanced business and leadership skills.

Students study a series of 30-credit modules that build knowledge and skills across key areas of management before applying their learning to a live consultancy project.

Instead of completing a traditional dissertation, students work on a real business challenge for an organisation. This approach enables students to develop practical, evidence-based solutions in a professional setting rather than focusing solely on a theoretical exercise. Students gain experience in applying their thinking to genuine deadlines and graduate with a real-life example of the value they can bring to an organisation.

The forward-thinking Global MBA focuses on real-world business challenges, embedding international perspectives and AI across the modules to reflect the realities of modern business.

Key areas of study include

  • Core business foundations: Develops a strong grounding in finance, marketing, operations, people and strategy.
  • AI and digital transformation: Explores how digital technologies are reshaping industries and decision-making and how they can drive smarter business outcomes.
  • Global perspective: Develops an international mindset while examining how culture, geopolitics and economics influence global business.
  • Leadership in practice: Strengthens the ability to lead teams, manage complex situations and communicate effectively.
  • Entrepreneurial thinking: Develops innovative and agile approaches to problem-solving.
  • Personal development: Builds confidence and resilience while supporting professional development and clearer career direction.
  • Ethical business: Develops responsible leadership skills through an understanding of the ethical, social and sustainability challenges facing businesses today.
